name_note: Most catalog genomes GTDB assigns to this species carry the NCBI name Faecalibacterium prausnitzii, so papers using that older name may describe organisms GTDB now places in Faecalibacterium taiwanense.

sentences.text: Faecalibacterium taiwanense was named for two obligately anaerobic, butyrate-producing, Gram-stain-negative strains isolated from faecal samples of two healthy Taiwanese adults.

In that description the two strains formed an independent robust cluster together with Faecalibacterium prausnitzii, and were differentiated from their closest Faecalibacterium species by cellular fatty acid compositions.
A study that describes the genus Faecalibacterium as one of the most important butyrate producers in the human intestinal tract assigned two further isolates to Faecalibacterium taiwanense.
